stem: How long is the Analytical Writing section, which consists of one Issue task?
explanation: The single Analyze an Issue task is allotted 30 minutes.

choiceExplanations.A: That is the first Verbal section.
choiceExplanations.B: That is the first Quantitative section.
choiceExplanations.C: That is the second Verbal section.
choiceExplanations.D: That is the second Quantitative section.

stem: Which section is always first on the GRE General Test?
explanation: Analytical Writing is always first; Verbal and Quantitative sections follow in any order.

choiceExplanations.A: Verbal sections may appear in any order after Analytical Writing.
choiceExplanations.B: Quant sections may also come in any order after Analytical Writing.
choiceExplanations.D: You do not choose the order.
choiceExplanations.E: A research section, if present, comes at the end.

stem: How many minutes in total are allotted across the five sections of the current GRE General Test?

explanation: Only the position of Analytical Writing is fixed.

choiceExplanations.A: The two measures may appear in any order.
choiceExplanations.B: The two measures may appear in any order.
choiceExplanations.E: It is always the first section.

choices.text: Analytical Writing is first, and the Verbal and Quant sections can follow in any order.

stem: How many Verbal and Quantitative questions are there in total across the four sections (two Verbal, two Quantitative)?
The second Quantitative section has 15 questions in 26 minutes. If you spend the same time on each question, how many seconds is that per question?
In the first Quantitative section (12 questions, 21 minutes), a test-taker has used 9 minutes and answered 4 questions. How many minutes per remaining question are left?
explanation: $21-9=12$ minutes remain for $12-4=8$ questions: $12\div8=1.5$ minutes each, below the original 1.75, so the pace must speed up.

choiceExplanations.A: $12$ minutes remain for 8 questions, not for 12.
choiceExplanations.B: Not the ratio of remaining time to remaining questions.
choiceExplanations.E: That is the pace so far, $9\div4$.

stem: Which of the following statements about the current GRE General Test are true? Indicate all such statements.
explanation: Quant sections run 21 and 26 minutes; Verbal 12 and 15 questions; the total is 118 minutes; the Argument task and 20-question sections belong to the older format.

choiceExplanations.B: The current test has only one Analyze an Issue task.
choiceExplanations.D: That was the format before September 22, 2023.

choices.text: Verbal Reasoning has two sections, one with 12 questions and one with 15.
Analytical Writing contains both an Issue task and an Argument task.
The whole test takes roughly 1 hour 58 minutes.

explanation: The current Quantitative sections are 12 questions in 21 minutes and 15 questions in 26 minutes.
